Text.Text: Sorry chum... I've been told i'm not allowed to sell anymore droids... Apparently I've had to many complaints about them randomly combusting and exploding. I mean, I did tell them it was a possibility and that it's a perk of having a droid like that? Maybe they didn't read the fine print or maybe they ju-... *The woman seems to ramble on and on about droids she has sold, you decide it is best to just walk away.*
